title: Balanced chord corpus manifest
description: Machine-checkable shape of the SDD Ch14 §7.1 chord corpus (E14-R25, ADR 0538). Enforced by hand-written validation in lib/features/live/domain/evaluation/chord_corpus_manifest.dart (ADR 0354 D8 precedent: no schema-library dependency). Carries NO audio — only per-item metadata plus a corpus content hash (ADR 0354 D1). Every recording-condition field is REQUIRED: a field that may be missing is a field that will be missing exactly where the analysis needs it. A synthetic corpus is a first-class, explicitly labelled kind and is refused as release-gate evidence (SDD Ch14 §12/2).

schemaVersion.description: Manifest contract version. Any other value is a typed ChordCorpusConfigException.

corpusId.description: Stable corpus identifier, e.g. strumsight-phone-majmin-v1 or guitarset-majmin.

corpusKind.description: realAudio: recorded from a real guitar and microphone. synthetic: generated — usable to exercise the validator and decoder plumbing, NEVER as release evidence (ChordCorpusManifest.gateEvidenceRefusal).

corpusSha256.description: Content hash of the audio this manifest describes. The audio itself never enters the repository.

items.description: One entry per recording. itemId must be unique across the corpus.

label.description: One of the 24 supported maj/min classes (assets/ml/model_manifest.json output_classes minus N.C.), or the reserved "noChord" label. An out-of-vocabulary chord (sus4, add9, 7th) belongs in the open-set corpus, not here — the validator rejects it, so a balanced maj/min corpus can never quietly absorb one.

capo.description: Fret the capo sits on; 0 for no capo.

room.description: Room identifier — a grouped-split key (recognition_split.dart GroupKey.room).

device.description: Phone model identifier — a grouped-split key.

hardNegativeCategory.description: A category id from evaluation/recognition/negative_taxonomy.json when this item is a hard negative, otherwise null. A hard negative must carry label "noChord" — the validator enforces it.
